key_insight: Insulin4RL is a real-world ICU insulin dataset designed to support offline reinforcement learning with naturally irregular clinical timing instead of fixed time bins.
clinical_relevance: It may help researchers build and test insulin titration models that better reflect how critically ill patients are actually monitored and treated.
method: Includes over 375,000 labelled insulin titration decisions from 12,209 patients
Uses fitted Q-evaluation and baseline model-free offline RL metrics
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a large retrospective dataset with irregularly sampled inputs/actions and a standardized evaluation protocol for offline RL.
watch_item: Because it is retrospective and observational, model performance may still be sensitive to dataset bias, confounding, and limited transportability to other ICUs.
paper_title: Insulin4RL: Real-Time Insulin Management in the Intensive Care Unit for Offline Reinforcement Learning
